techniques.name: Automatic curriculum generation
techniques.goal: Select progressively useful tasks without a human-authored curriculum
techniques.mechanism: Generate next objectives from current capabilities/state to maximize novelty/progress, then validate outcomes and update capability state.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use user-value/roadmap constraints around automatic curriculum; never let novelty outrank user priorities.
avoid_when: Production work where user priority controls task order

techniques.name: Executable skill library from successful trajectories
techniques.goal: Compound capabilities by converting successful behavior into reusable procedures
techniques.mechanism: Store validated executable code/workflows with descriptions, preconditions and retrieval metadata; retrieve/combine on later tasks.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Directly supports Agent OS Skill Miner; require replay eval and versioned dependencies.

techniques.name: Environment-feedback iterative program repair
techniques.goal: Improve generated code by incorporating runtime errors and task-state feedback
techniques.mechanism: Execute candidate in sandbox, feed structured errors/results back, patch, and repeat until validator passes or budget expires.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Already compatible with Orchestrator reviewer/repair loop; add failure-to-regression capture.

techniques.name: Evolutionary reward-function design
techniques.goal: Automate objective/reward code discovery where performance can be simulated
techniques.mechanism: LLM proposes executable reward code; environment trains/evaluates policy; scores and textual feedback seed next reward variants.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Useful conceptual pattern: generate objective candidates, but validate against independent user-value metrics.
avoid_when: Personal Agent OS objective with incomplete proxy

techniques.name: Evolutionary program search with LLM mutation
techniques.goal: Discover algorithms beyond one-shot model generation
techniques.mechanism: Maintain population of executable programs; sample strong/diverse parents; LLM mutates; objective evaluator accepts/scores offspring; repeat.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Potential Meta Engine optimizer only for bounded code/config functions with sandbox + protected holdout.
avoid_when: Subjective behavior with no strong evaluator

techniques.name: Best-shot prompting from elite candidates
techniques.goal: Bias mutation toward proven high-performing structures
techniques.mechanism: Include several high-scoring programs/solutions in prompt as exemplars and ask model to improve/combine them.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use with diversity islands and holdout, not as standalone proof of quality.

techniques.name: Skeletonized search / evolve only critical function
techniques.goal: Shrink search space and preserve known-correct infrastructure
techniques.mechanism: Keep boilerplate/control/safety fixed and expose only a bounded function/config region to evolutionary modification.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Strong fit: Meta Engine should prefer bounded mutable surfaces over repository-wide self-editing.
risks: Fixed skeleton can prevent better architecture

techniques.name: Island-based quality-diversity search
techniques.goal: Avoid premature convergence while preserving multiple high-quality niches
techniques.mechanism: Maintain separate subpopulations/islands, occasionally migrate/reseed, and optimize quality while retaining diversity.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: If used, cap archive/search budget and value diversity only when it improves holdout outcomes.

techniques.name: Fast/strong model ensemble for evolutionary proposal generation
techniques.goal: Use cheap models for breadth and expensive models for depth in candidate generation
techniques.mechanism: Generate many mutations with fast model; selectively invoke strongest model for difficult/elite improvements.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Natural extension of Agent OS model router under experiment budget.

techniques.name: Automated evaluator-driven algorithm discovery
techniques.goal: Let objective evaluators substitute for subjective model judgment
techniques.mechanism: Candidate code is executed/scored by deterministic domain metrics; search feedback comes from measured result.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Central safe self-improvement motif: machine creativity + hard external oracle.

techniques.name: Full agent code search (ADAS / Meta Agent Search)
techniques.goal: Discover agent architectures beyond human-authored templates
techniques.mechanism: Represent complete agent system in code; meta-agent proposes new agent code using archive of prior designs; evaluate and retain stronger variants.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Never allow candidate to modify authorization, audit, holdout or promotion gates; generated code is untrusted.
use_when: Sandbox research branch with strong evals

techniques.name: Open-ended self-modification archive (Darwin Gödel Machine)
techniques.goal: Explore divergent self-improvement paths rather than greedily replacing one incumbent
techniques.mechanism: Sample existing agent from growing archive, let it modify its own implementation, evaluate offspring and retain diverse successful variants.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Agent OS may borrow archive/champion-challenger ideas, not unrestricted self-modification.
avoid_when: Personal production Agent OS control plane

techniques.name: Minimal persistent policy repair from abstracted failures
techniques.goal: Turn repeated failures into small reusable policy changes rather than long reflections
techniques.mechanism: Abstract failure into concise strategy, make minimal patch to policy/code, test on unseen cases and retain if beneficial.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Strong research fit if patches target versioned prompt/workflow assets under eval gates.

techniques.name: Modular agent design-space search
techniques.goal: Search combinations of planning/reasoning/tool/memory modules instead of unconstrained code
techniques.mechanism: Define uniform module interfaces, evolve/recombine module variants and evaluate whole-agent configurations.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Matches technique-interaction registry; search over curated safe modules before full code search.
avoid_when: Module taxonomy is immature or constraining

techniques.name: Surrogate performance predictor for agent search
techniques.goal: Avoid evaluating obviously weak candidate architectures
techniques.mechanism: Train/use predictor from prior evaluated designs to estimate performance and skip low-potential candidates.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Require random exploration quota to detect predictor blind spots.
use_when: Expensive agent architecture search with many evaluations

techniques.name: Inference-time architecture search
techniques.goal: Automatically choose combinations of sampling, ranking, critique, fusion, verification and models under a budget
techniques.mechanism: Search modular inference pipelines against target evals/cost limits and select Pareto-optimal architectures.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: One of strongest direct inspirations for future Meta Engine; search only pre-approved techniques and validate on private holdout.
avoid_when: Tiny stable task with obvious route

techniques.name: Policy-level trajectory reflection
techniques.goal: Improve long-horizon behavior by updating beliefs/policy from full trajectories rather than single mistakes
techniques.mechanism: Summarize outcomes and strategic errors across trajectories, modify persistent policy, and search refinements.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use failure clusters + experiments rather than accepting model-generated causal explanation.

techniques.name: MCTS agent search over actions/reasoning
techniques.goal: Trade substantial test-time compute for better interactive decisions
techniques.mechanism: Build search tree over actions/reasoning; use environment feedback, value estimates and reflection to select branches.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Only simulate/search over reversible/sandbox actions; real action remains outside tree until selected/authorized.
avoid_when: Actions have real irreversible side effects

techniques.name: Automated process supervision for agents
techniques.goal: Detect bad intermediate decisions before they propagate
techniques.mechanism: Use search to generate step labels, train process reward model, and rejection-sample away from low-quality paths.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Application-level analogue is deterministic stage validation; far simpler and more auditable.
avoid_when: Hosted Agent OS orchestration can directly validate steps

techniques.name: Layered Mixture-of-Agents
techniques.goal: Aggregate diverse LLM outputs through multiple synthesis layers
techniques.mechanism: Run several models/agents in parallel; subsequent agents read prior layer outputs as auxiliary evidence; repeat.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Prefer one strong synthesizer over evidence artifacts; compare to cheaper best-of-N/independent review.

techniques.name: Proactive information-gap elicitation
techniques.goal: Ask targeted questions only when hidden user knowledge materially affects solution quality
techniques.mechanism: Detect missing task information and choose questions expected to elicit novel actionable user context rather than generic clarification.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Agent OS should retrieve existing personal/project context before questioning; question only for material unresolved gaps.

techniques.name: Tunable proactivity threshold
techniques.goal: Adapt how aggressively the system recommends/interrupts
techniques.mechanism: Expose or learn a threshold balancing intervention benefit, confidence and user interruption preference.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Maintain per-channel/domain thresholds plus hard urgency/security overrides.
avoid_when: Safety-critical alert whose policy threshold is fixed
risks: Feedback loops can overfit to short-term dismissal

techniques.name: Quality-diversity archive rather than single incumbent
techniques.goal: Preserve alternative solutions that may become useful under new tasks/models/constraints
techniques.mechanism: Retain diverse Pareto/niche variants instead of replacing everything with current top scorer.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Keep small champion + challengers + historically distinct approaches; archive terminal variants compactly.

techniques.name: Evaluator-immutable self-improvement sandbox
techniques.goal: Allow aggressive candidate self-improvement without letting candidates weaken the test that judges them
techniques.mechanism: Run candidate changes in isolated branch/sandbox; evaluator, holdout, authorization, audit and budget policies are mounted read-only/outside candidate modification scope.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Non-negotiable boundary for future Meta Engine architecture search.

techniques.name: Self-improvement search budget + stopping rule
techniques.goal: Prevent open-ended optimization from consuming unlimited compute for diminishing gains
techniques.mechanism: Cap evaluations/tokens/time/candidate archive; stop on no-improvement, confidence, value-of-information or error-budget condition.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Meta-overhead budget is part of every automated optimizer contract.
